result_text:
I fixed the patterns for all four broken default conventions. I ran the `codeanalyzer` tests and they passed, but I didn't add a test for the new matches or exercise them on sample files.

**`GeneratedConventions.java`**
- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and `<meta name="generator">` rules had `(html|html|xhtml)` with `html` listed twice. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match as well.
- **`// Generated by …` JavaScript:** the file pattern `.*/[.]js` only matched a file literally named `.js`. It is now `.*[.]js`.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML:** the file pattern `.*/[.]xml` is now `.*[.]xml`.

**`BuildAndDeploymentConventions.java`**
- **Gradle scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` required a dot before the dash, so it only matched `.-gradle.js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, which matches `build-gradle.js`.

I left the content patterns alone, so hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of those scopes unless they carry the generated-code markers.

I didn't touch `.*/[.](css|js)[.]map` in `GeneratedConventions.java:40`. It has the same kind of typo, but it wasn't in your list.
